slides.title: YouTube's AI editor will *add your text hooks* for you
slides.subtitle: 5 Made On YouTube updates worth knowing

slides.label: 01 · Edit by chat
slides.title: A Gemini editing assistant
slides.body: Type to *trim speech, sync music, add text hooks and reorder frames* in Shorts and YouTube Create. TechCrunch reports it should arrive early next year.

slides.label: 02 · Shorts series
slides.title: Seasons and episodes
slides.body: Creators can group Shorts into seasons and episodes, built for episodic stories and microdramas on mobile and TV. Brands can brief a series, not just one video.

slides.label: 03 · Likeness detection
slides.title: Protect your face and voice
slides.body: YouTube is expanding likeness detection to cover creators' *voice and face*. As AI copies get easier to make, this becomes part of every partnership conversation.

slides.label: 04 · Brand deals
slides.title: Get found by brands on YouTube
slides.body: YouTube highlighted new ways to get noticed by brands and resources for pitching partnerships. More of the deal process may move onto the platform.

slides.label: 05 · Live auto-dubbing
slides.title: Streams in other languages
slides.body: Real-time auto-dubbing for live streams. A live launch or Q&A can reach viewers who don't speak the creator's language.
